title: Kurvo
message: [AI] KUR-444: The add stop functionality. When pasting in a google maps link/gps coords/ apple maps or whatever also works right now in the “where to” input field. It should show the different stops from the link if more than one, and a selection for each of the stop to be able to add more than one. And if only one stop in the link it should just auto-select that - like what the where to does. (#1206)
